name: PCC Referral
job: PCC QR referral routing. Enrolls on utm_source=pcc_qr, stamps live tag pcc-referral and next-lander so WF-01 owns create-once for the Sales opp.

trigger.notes: Do not create the Sales opp here. Stamp next-lander so the WF-01 trigger (Contact Created + next-lander) enrolls the contact.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Contact Created (utm_source = pcc_qr)
named_steps.comment: Sole enroll. Do not fire on other utm_source values.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: pcc-referral (live tag)
named_steps.comment: Live tag. Do not rename pcc-referral.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_ref_pcc (audit)
named_steps.comment: New v2 audit tag for the PCC channel.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: contact.referral_channel = pcc_qr
named_steps.comment: Native field write. Do not touch location_* fields (WF-01 owns Method 2 stamps).

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: next-lander (so WF-01 trigger enrolls)
named_steps.comment: Live tag next-lander is required by the WF-01 trigger (Contact Created + next-lander). Do not rename next-lander.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Re-enter WF-01 Lead Capture (create-once owner)
named_steps.comment: WF-01 owns the Sales opp create-once. Do not create a Sales opp here.
